services_shape: visit types in the clinic's exam rooms, and at a home or a field, each with a set length; a sports physical is a yearly check for a school sport; an injury exam is a history, an exam and a plan, with imaging only when the doctor orders it; a return to play is written only by a doctor after an exam; a plan of care's follow-ups are booked as a series only with the patient's own yes, and each is paid when it happens
questions_before_times: for you, or for your child (a parent or guardian books a minor, who stays)
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the 45-minute new injury exam)
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never an injury described in the AI chat
a school sport, a car accident, or a work injury (then it's billed to that claim)
a health plan (its name only), or paying yourself
safety_stop: trouble breathing, chest pain, collapsing or passing out during exercise, a seizure, or a head hit with vomiting, confusion, a worse headache or drowsiness
a bone poking through the skin, a joint badly out of line, or a limb that's cold, pale or can't move; or heat with vomiting or confusion
first_steps: The claim for a school, auto, or work injury
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
license: each sports doctor holds their own state medical license; the clinic where the state's form asks
staff_skills: sports doctors: exams, injury care, sports physicals, return-to-play notes and imaging orders; the front desk: check-in, plan checks, school forms, estimates and payment; only people cleared for home and field visits go out
messages_never: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the injury, the visit type, the reason, the plan or the doctor's name (at home or a field, the doctor's name stays, for the door check)
